desc: Write the full `Solution` class with `countGoodArrays` method implementing the formula C(n-1, k) * m * (m-1)^(n-k-1) mod 1e9+7.
Precompute factorials and inverse factorials up to n-1 (or n) in O(n) time.
Compute binomial coefficient C(n-1, k) using modular arithmetic.
Compute modular exponentiation for (m-1)^(n-k-1) with proper edge case handling (e.g., when m-1 = 0 and exponent > 0, result is 0).
Multiply components together and return the result modulo 10^9+7.
Test the implementation against the three provided examples.
Verify edge cases: m=1, k=n-1 returns 1; m=1, k≠n-1 returns 0; k=0 returns m * (m-1)^(n-1) correctly.
